title: Font atlas metadata
description: font/main_meta.yaml: the glyphs of the font atlas font/main.png, written by dwx extract (packages/formats/src/text/font.cpp).

cell_width.description: Width of an atlas cell in pixels.

fallback.description: Index of the glyph drawn for characters the font lacks.

colors.description: The 15-bit colours of the atlas palette in hex.

sjis.description: The Shift JIS code of the glyph in hex.

character.description: The glyph as UTF-8, or null when the code has no Unicode character.

ascii.description: The ASCII character the game text maps to this glyph, or null.

x.description: Left edge of the cell in the atlas.
